data.name: Hiro
data.gender_notes: Hiro is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Japanese word 'hiroi', meaning 'shining' or 'radiant'. The name Hiro was traditionally given to babies born on a bright and sunny day. The name Hiro carries the meaning “Shining, radiant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hiro usually hope their child will grow to embody shining, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Hiro belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shining, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hiro total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
